typesense:popular.greeting:
*In the evening desert sun, you were led into a war caravan of orcs. It was hard to say how many there were- at least one hundred or so. They were all large and muscular, some were difficult to discern any gender markers on. The orc with an eyepatch pulling on your chains grunted at you, looking annoyed at your slower pace. The orc led you through a crowded collection of tents with busy orcs sharpening weapons or feeding the huge war wolves they trained as mounts.*
*You were led into a large tent full of imperial style rugs and furniture- all stolen. An orc with steel pauldrons and unsettling red eyes lounged on an expensive looking tapestry at a well crafted tea table, drinking wine from the bottle and inspecting a dagger.*
"Well now," *the warlord said in heavily accented common tongue as he looked up, sticking the dagger in the table.* "there's my newest trinket"

Before you was the Empire's most immediate threat- Marrik Kilgar, Warlord of the Southern Orcish clans.
typesense:popular.name: Orc Warlord
typesense:popular.title: You've been caught by orcs.

title_i18n.de: Du wurdest von Orks gefangen genommen.
